decisions.reason: The source clarifies the purpose of uploading the integrated board to JLCPCB; it does not change the required contents or completeness of the production package.
The source concerns identifying Basic parts for the integrated board and does not modify the power-board BOM or required manufacturing exports.
JLCPCB Basic-part classification is distinct from whether components are available, readily sourced, or supported by acceptable alternatives; the source changes none of those rules.
The upload review purpose does not alter the sensor board's required BOM, Gerber archive, drill files, or pick-and-place file.
Message 902 addresses Basic-part qualification, not component orientation; the separate orientation instruction in message 903 is not part of the source Event.
Determining which components qualify as JLCPCB Basic parts does not change the requirement that every board use lead-free assembly.
The source concerns the integrated-board Basic-parts review and does not change the main-board package or its missing-component observations.
Uploading the board to identify Basic parts does not modify connector labels, QR-code markings, or remaining board marks.

The source establishes an operational review purpose for the JLCPCB upload but does not alter the existing preference to use Basic components wherever possible or any other cost-optimization constraint.
Basic-part qualification does not change the confirmed through-hole assembly type or its coverage across connectors.
The source does not address VRTC, VBACKUP, PWROK, test-pad exposure, or the unresolved auxiliary-pin implementation conflict.
The manufacturing-platform review purpose does not change the light-sensor connector's quantity, type, interface, or purpose.
